name: Khichuri with Egg
description: A warming one-pot blend of rice and lentils, slow-cooked with turmeric and cumin, finished with a boiled egg on the side. Saturday's fixed lunch — comfort food built for a full afternoon shift.

name: Fish Curry with Rice
description: River fish cooked in a light turmeric-forward curry, a Monday cafeteria tradition. Served with steamed rice and a wedge of lime.

name: Chicken Curry with Rice
description: Bone-in chicken slow-cooked in a rich onion-tomato masala, Tuesday's fixed meal — the one most people ask for seconds of.

name: Beef Curry with Rice
description: Slow-braised beef in a deep, dark bhuna-style curry. Wednesday's fixed meal, and the kitchen's most-requested dish company-wide.

name: Mixed Vegetable with Rice
description: A lighter Thursday option — seasonal vegetables tempered with panch phoron, served with steamed rice. The go-to for anyone easing off heavier meals.

name: Grilled Sandwich
description: Toasted bread layered with vegetables, cheese, and a smoky sauce. Available any day for Custom Menu employees and guests.

name: Chicken Fried Rice
description: Wok-tossed rice with chicken, egg, and vegetables. A quick, filling à la carte option available every day.

name: Coffee
description: Freshly brewed, served hot. The unofficial fuel of every 3pm meeting.

name: Fresh Lime Water
description: Lime, a touch of salt and sugar, ice-cold. The house cure for a heavy lunch.

name: Vegetable Samosa
description: Crisp pastry parcels filled with spiced potato and peas. An evening-shift favorite.

name: Singara
description: Bengal's take on the samosa — smaller, spicier, with a distinct triangular fold.

name: Beef Roll
description: Spiced minced beef wrapped in a flaky paratha roll. A hearty evening snack.
